thread_text:
devon: FYI acme-inc on prod reported a big p99 spike and intermittent 401s starting ~03:10 UTC. Customer complaining about slow / failing responses.

maria: I see the alert—p95 steady, p99 up ~820ms on continuous-batcher pool us-west-2-cb-3.

tara: Any recent config/deploy around that time?

devon: Rolled a small change to continuous-batcher grace_window at 02:58 (reduce default from 6ms -> 2ms). Also tenant auth token rotation for acme happened overnight.

kevin: Looking at proxy logs: lots of requests are being coalesced and held waiting for batch, then auth checks return 401 after ~5s (token refresh race). So requests wait in batch hold -> auth fails -> retries -> billing churn.

ops-bot: ```
[03:09:54] request_id=abc123 tenant=acme wait_ms=2500 batch_size=7 auth_status=200 latency_ms=310
[03:10:01] request_id=def456 tenant=acme wait_ms=5200 batch_size=2 auth_status=401 latency_ms=5120
[03:10:03] request_id=ghi789 tenant=acme wait_ms=4800 batch_size=1 auth_status=401 latency_ms=4880
```

maria: Repro steps I used: send 20 rapid tiny prompts (~50 tokens) to /v1/generate with tenant token that is in the middle of a refresh window; p99 ~4.9s, many 401s.

kevin: Quick hypothesis: reducing grace_window increased the number of tiny requests that miss a batch and instead sit in a lingering hold path where they wait longer for a matching batch and hit expired auth tokens.

tara: Also billing noted some spikes. @billing-bot any details?

billing-bot: Received multiple invoice events: tenant acme had 3x token retry attempts logged between 03:09–03:12, leading to higher token-check count. We also saw a couple of 402 webhook responses during retry storms.

maria: Proposed quick mitigations: 1) set tenant-level continuous-batcher.fast_path=true for acme (short-circuit tiny requests) 2) reduce retry count on 401 from 3->1 for now 3) revert grace_window to previous value on the global pool.

kevin: I can push a per-tenant config. Example admin API call: ```bash
curl -X PATCH https://admin.redwood.internal/tenants/acme/batcher-config \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"continuous_batcher": {"fast_path": true, "min_batch_size": 1, "grace_window_ms": 6}}'
```

devon: Do that as a hotfix. Also gate it to the dedicated pool for acme so we don't affect others.

ops-bot: Hotfix applied at 03:18 UTC: tenant acme fast_path=true on us-west-2-cb-3; retry_count_on_401=1 globally for 10m.

kevin: After hotfix p99 dropped from ~820ms -> ~240ms for acme, 401 rate dropped by ~85%.

maria: Short-term rollback plan: roll global grace_window back to 6ms in the next 10m canary to confirm no regression for other tenants. Long-term: we need a proper tiny-request fast path + token refresh jitter smoothing.

tara: Action items:
- kevin: add texture metric batch_hold_duration and emit per-tenant hold buckets (low/med/high)
- maria: correlate auth token refresh schedule with hold duration and propose token jitter fix
- devon: schedule canary rollback of grace_window and monitor p99 across pools
- sre-oncall: prepare postmortem if SLO impacted for >1h

sre-oncall: Logged incident INC-2026-0418 and set priority P2.

maria: Small note — we should also add a short-circuit on auth 401 to avoid retry amplification when hold_duration > 1s.

kevin: Will open PR for short-circuit and a per-tenant fast_path flag in the runtime. PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/continuous-batcher/pulls/487 (canary only).

billing-bot: We'll follow up with acme finance contact to explain overage cause; created ticket BILL-965.

devon: Good work. Temporary mitigations held. Follow-ups next week: design doc for tiny-request fast path and token-refresh resilience.

maria: Closing thread for now — monitoring dashboards show stable p99 after 03:25 UTC. Please keep adding notes to INC-2026-0418. :thumbsup:
